links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified IR reports (FRE, FKGL, SMOG, Dale-Chall)
links.effect: GPT-4 median FRE 69.01 (IQR 64.88-73.14) vs Claude-3-Opus 59.74 (IQR 55.47-64.01); GPT-4 outperformed Claude-3-Opus, GPT-3.5-Turbo and Gemini Ultra (p<0.001).
links.quote: Quantitatively, GPT-4 surpassed Claude-3-Opus in all readability metrics (all p < 0.001), with a median FRE score of 69.01 (IQR: 64.88-73.14) versus 59.74 (IQR: 55.47-64.01) for Claude-3-Opus.

links.outcome: Content, trust-breaking and post-therapy misconduct errors in LLM-simplified reports
links.effect: All models exhibited some trust-breaking and post-therapy misconduct errors; GPT-4 had fewest content and trust-breaking errors, Mistral models highest.
links.quote: However, all models exhibited some level of trust-breaking and post-therapy misconduct errors, with GPT-4-Turbo and GPT-3.5-Turbo with few-shot prompting showing the lowest error rates, and Mistral-7B and Mistral-8×7B showing the highest.

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares multiple commercial and open-source LLMs in simplifying interventional radiology reports for patient comprehension, measuring readability and clinical error rates.
